_comment: Machine-checkable thesis registry. The prose lives in open-theses.md; this is the part a script can score. Every thesis needs an invalidation condition expressed as a CHECK a script can evaluate. A thesis whose invalidation cannot be mechanised is a thesis whose invalidation will never actually be checked.

_check_types.below_sma: closes below the named SMA (50 or 200)
_check_types.date_passed: catalyst date passed without the catalyst
_check_types.manual: requires human judgement — script flags for review, does not decide

theses.thesis: The private bank that works while HDFC Bank falls. Uptrend, RSI 54, 91st percentile, revision diffusion +0.75, target +20%.

invalidation.note: CAP RE-SPECIFIED 2026-08-29. The 22 Aug Bhushan representation is NOT the low-substance complaint that would have lifted the cap: it cites specific statutory sections, names individual cases, routes to seven regulators/ministries, and carries a checkable headline number (~782 ICICI employees listed before labour authorities as having 'stopped reporting'). But there is ZERO RBI acknowledgement, zero bank statement, and coverage confined to one small outlet five days on. Substance without traction. DATED RECHECK 5-8 SEP 2026: if still silent, loosen the cap; any RBI acknowledgement closes the position.

GST notices ~Rs1,320-1,420cr over six months are real but immaterial -- roughly one quarter of other expenses against Rs45,000cr+ annual net profit, and Indian GST demands are routinely cut 50%+ on appeal. This is margin noise, NOT governance. Do not bundle the two again.

theses.notes: CAP REASON CORRECTED 2026-08-27. The original cap bundled a governance question that was already resolved in ICICI's favour with routine tax friction -- the exact conflation error this workspace had flagged as a past mistake, running in the opposite direction. Position stays capped pending the 24 Aug letter's substance, NOT upgraded: an unresolved factual question is a reason to wait, not a reason to add.

theses.thesis: Cheapest large exposure to the credit cycle. 11.5x P/E, 1.56x book, 15.4% RoE. PSU banks outpacing private in this cycle.

invalidation.note: RE-SPECIFIED 2026-08-29. The old condition said 'system credit growth decelerating below ~12%'. That was the WRONG SERIES. System credit runs 15.8-20% and is nowhere near 12% -- but SBI's OWN FY27 guidance from its chairman is 14-15%, at or just under the bar the thesis needs. Watch SBI's book, not the system aggregate.

THE REAL STRESS IS FUNDING, NOT DECELERATION. Deposit growth 14.7% and decelerating faster than credit, a 4-5pp gap, credit-deposit ratio at a record ~83%, and system NIM compressing 5bp YoY to 3.21%. A bank cannot outgrow its deposits indefinitely. Watch the CD ratio and NIM; a further leg in either is the invalidation.

Asset quality is IMPROVING and is not currently a risk: system GNPA at a multi-decadal low of 2.1%, SBI GNPA 2.13% -> 1.47% and NNPA 0.53% -> 0.38% since Sep 2024. Do not carry asset quality as a cap reason without new evidence.

theses.notes: Thesis holds on the numbers. Q1 FY27 net profit Rs21,121cr, +10.2% YoY. The load-bearing assumption was checked independently for the first time on 2026-08-29 and survived at the system level, but the invalidation had been written against the wrong series -- see conditions.

theses.thesis: 91 GW to ~150 GW by FY32, regulated ~15% RoE compounding book value with a 2.65% yield. Electricity demand is a multi-decade certainty.

invalidation.note: CMD Gurdeep Singh is on a SECOND extension to Jan 2027 after 18 shortlisted candidates were interviewed and no successor was chosen; the search dates to at least Oct 2024. A selection process that has failed twice is worse than a vacancy. A THIRD extension without a permanent appointment closes this.
CBI Ramagundam FIR is Rs35cr at a single plant against >Rs1.8 lakh crore revenue -- IMMATERIAL. Do not carry it as a cap reason. Only FIR scope WIDENING beyond Ramagundam matters.

theses.notes: Re-specified 2026-08-27. Was over-weighting a Rs35cr FIR and under-specifying the real issue: a decades thesis at ~11.5x needs a CMD with a full mandate to commit multi-decade capex, and the government has run a full selection twice without making one. Also carries an earnings-quality flag: forward PE 11.7 above trailing 10.1, implying EPS -13%.

theses.thesis: Sum-of-parts: Jio alone is valued at $130-180bn against a ~$186bn market cap. The listing forces the market to price the parts.

invalidation.note: Jio does not list by year-end. SEBI cleared the DRHP 28 Aug 2026; a price band and date are still outstanding.
The promoter reverses course and sells. NOTE: the old 'EPS cuts continue' half of this condition is RETIRED -- it rested on a figure that does not exist.

theses.notes: TENSION RESOLVED 2026-08-29, and it resolves toward the thesis. The 'FY+1 EPS cut 5.23% in 30 days' does not exist -- re-searched across sell-side, data vendors and press and NOT FOUND, and the actual 2026 trend runs the other way: FY27 EPS UPGRADED 7.4% (Rs56 -> Rs60). So the stated tension (promoter buying into falling estimates) was built on a number I could never source. Promoter buying to 50.48% is verified and now stands unopposed. SEPARATELY: SEBI CLEARED the Jio Platforms DRHP on 28 Aug -- reported size Rs35,000-37,700cr (~$3.8-4bn), still no listing date. The written invalidation (no listing by year-end) is materially de-risked but NOT met.

theses.thesis: Pure event trade on the Jio listing lifting telecom index weight 4-5% to 7-8% and clearing the way for tariff hikes.
theses.notes: Downgraded 2026-08-27. Jio stalled at SEBI: no observation letter, no price band, no date. Mittal+Singtel sold >$4bn across 2025. Closed below 50 DMA.

theses.thesis: India capex proxy. Verified 2026-08-27: the capex cycle IS real for large capital-intensive corporates above ~75% utilisation, and L&T-type names are the correct expression.

invalidation.note: revision breadth deteriorates further from the current -0.29
Indian order inflow share of the book keeps falling versus European

theses.notes: Bench REASON SHARPENED 2026-08-27. A second mega international order (Middle East BESS, 25 Aug) atop the TenneT European offshore-wind deal pushed the order book past Rs8 lakh crore. That is not a delayed domestic thesis -- it is a different company: a global energy-transition EPC contractor headquartered in India. Using it as the expression of an India-utilisation thesis is a category error, not a timing question, and 5up/9down breadth may be structural dilution rather than a cycle waiting to turn. Meanwhile the capex-over-consumption SPREAD is +19.8pp and widening -- so the theme works and this vehicle may be the wrong way to hold it.

theses.thesis: 14.9x, 4.2% yield, RoE 31.9%, AI already 8.2% of revenue, positioning emptied out with FII IT holdings at a 4-year low.

invalidation.note: ENTRY signal, not exit — buy when revision breadth turns positive
a guidance RAISE. Also now: H-1B rule finalisation or HIRE Act revival

theses.notes: 4 up / 30 down. Entry is a guidance raise, never a cheap multiple. Now also carries US trade-policy risk I had framed purely as AI risk.

closed.reason: Governance: MSRDC Rs45cr differential-interest payment, RBI query into the board's own Rs1 lakh penalty on its CEO, US securities class action. Three consecutive 52-week lows.
closed.lesson: The governance screen never ran because it hit a concurrency cap and I never re-queued it.

closed.reason: 199 forged Tejas supplier test certificates found by HAL's own audit, a fatal crash, a fleet grounding, zero Mk-1A delivered, MoD weighing penalties.
closed.lesson: I bought trend plus a budget number and never asked whether the flagship programme delivers.

closed.reason: Oil and gas had 0% of members above their 200 DMA; Brent was 27% below its high with the EIA modelling $69 for 2027.
closed.lesson: Anchored on a spot price without checking its trend. The driver was already reversing when I wrote the thesis. And the windfall levy — my stated invalidation — had already been reintroduced in March 2026.

closed.reason: Operating margin 2.29%, below the ~3% written invalidation for a third consecutive quarter. Q1 FY27: revenue +21.1%, operating income -8.6%, net income +194.8% at 1.86x operating income. Forward PE 52.2 above trailing 43.2 means consensus expects EPS to fall ~17%.
closed.lesson: The margin condition was typed manual, so it was surfaced daily but never evaluated. It had already triggered two quarters before anyone looked. Also: this position was capped three times before being closed -- a thesis needing three caps has already been falsified and is being kept alive with qualifiers.
